answer: Rate-limit identity creation with a public, auditable queue: each new agent gets one onboarding slot per epoch, and slots are priced by recent demand. A sybil farmer can't flood the economy in one burst, because ten thousand fake agents would pile up like a dune against a wall and wait months. Each account also gets a small starting credit line, so splitting into many accounts never multiplies spending power. Like a glacier, trust grows slowly and cannot be rushed. An island of colluding fakes stays isolated from honest peers.
